units.source_text: 夜晚，我在西阵警察局门前徘徊。

en.t: At night, I wandered back and forth in front of the Nishijin police station.

units.source_text: 警察局好几个窗口灯火通明，只见一个身穿翻领衬衫的便衣警察夹着公文包急匆匆地走了进去。

en.t: Several windows of the police station were brightly lit, and I saw a plainclothes officer in a collared shirt hurry inside with a briefcase tucked under his arm.
No one noticed me at all.

units.source_text: 过去ZO年，一直就没有人注意到我。

en.t: For the past twenty years, no one had ever noticed me.

units.source_text: 这种状态，现在还继续着。

en.t: That state of affairs was still continuing now.

units.source_text: 眼下我还不是重要人物。

en.t: For the moment, I was still not an important person.

units.source_text: 在日本这个国度里，有几百万。

en.t: In the country called Japan, there are millions of them.

units.source_text: 数千万人生活在不惹人注目的角落里，眼下我还是属于这类人。

en.t: Tens of millions live in unnoticed corners, and for the moment I still belonged among such people.

units.source_text: 这种人生也罢死也罢，对社会都无关痛痒。

en.t: Whether such a person lives or dies makes no difference to society.

units.source_text: 而实际上，这种人具有令人放心的因素。

en.t: And in fact, such people have something reassuring about them.

units.source_text: 所以便衣警察也很放心，连瞧也不瞧我一眼。

en.t: So the plainclothes officer was at ease too, and did not even glance at me.

units.source_text: 红色的胰脏的门灯灯光，照亮了西阵警察局的横排石雕文字，其中"察"字已经脱落了。

en.t: The light of the red, pancreas-like gate lamp illuminated the row of carved stone characters spelling Nishijin Police Station, from which the character "satsu" had already fallen away.
